title: STOP-PKD: SGLT2-inhibition to improve Prognosis in Polycystic Kidney Disease
official: STOP-PKD: SGLT2-inhibition to improve Prognosis in Polycystic Kidney Disease
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to assess whether dapagliflozin improves the decline of kidney function in patients with ADPKD on-treatment (between week 6 and EOT).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male and female patients with ADPKD (modified Ravine criteria) ≥ 18 and ≤ 60 years
2. Patients 18 - 39 years: eGFR ≥25 ml/min; patients 40 - 60 years: eGFR ≥25 and <90 ml/min/1.73 m2
3. Indicators of rapid progression, either of the following: - Mayo class 1D-E - Mayo class 1C AND EITHER  1. Truncating PKD1 mutation OR 2. eGFR loss > 3ml/min/year (determined by ≥ 4 creatinine values within 4 years, ≥ 6 months measurement intervals) OR 3. PROPKD score > 6 (patient history)
4. IF patient is on ACE-I /ARBs: stable dose for 4 weeks before screening
Exclusion criteria:
1. Treatment with tolvaptan, somatostatin analogue or SGLT2i within the last 3 months before screening
2. Pregnancy, breastfeeding or women of child-bearing potential not using effective contraception method
3. Not able to comply with the study protocol, in the investigator’s judgement
4. Not able to provide informed consent
5. Participation in any other interventional clinical trial in the last 2 months
6. Medical history of diabetic ketoacidosis, necrotizing fasciitis or organ transplantation
7. Diabetes mellitus type 1 or any type of diabetes mellitus due to insulin deficiency
8. Uncontrolled ongoing urinary tract or genital infections
9. Known intolerance of the study medication ingredients
10. Uncontrolled grade 2 hypertension (>160/100 mmHg)
11. Symptomatic hypotension, or systolic blood pressure <90 mmHg
12. Primary renal disease other than ADPKD
13. Hepatic impairment (aspartate transaminase [AST] or alanine transaminase [ALT]>3x the upper limit of normal [ULN]; or total bilirubin >2x ULN at time of enrolment)
